proposition: Ibn Turka was also remembered as Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī's teacher: MK calls Yazdī his chief disciple, and in Bākharzī's report of Jāmī, Yazdī himself said his knowledge was an instance of Ṣāʾin al-Dīn's benevolence and praised him constantly.

mediation.who: ʿAbd al-Vāsiʿ Niẓāmī Bākharzī, Maqāmāt-i Jāmī
mediation.note: hostile reporter: Yazdī's words reach us through Jāmī's circle, which is running Yazdī and Ibn Turka down; MK is translating a hostile reporter
